title: Check how much stock a branch has
text: Stock on Hand lists every product in one branch. It shows the quantity left, the cost, and the selling price.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Stock on Hand.
Search by name, code, or barcode. Or scan the item.
Click a category on the left to shorten the list.

title: Find low stock or items that ran out
text: The All Products filter shows only what needs a reorder. The low stock level is set on each product.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Stock on Hand.
Click the All Products filter in the top bar.
Pick Low stock for items at or below their warning level.
Pick Out of stock for items with nothing left.
To change a warning level, edit the product on the Products page. Set its Low Stock Quantity.

title: See where stock went
text: Stock History lists every change to one product. Deliveries, sales, counts, losses, and transfers, with who did it and when.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Stock on Hand.
Find the product.
Double-click its row. Stock History opens.
Filter by type or pick a period to narrow it down.
Click Export to send the history to Excel.

title: Fix a wrong stock number
text: You cannot type a stock number on Stock on Hand. Use the right page instead, so there is a record of why.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar.
Number is simply wrong? Click Stock Adjustment.
Items broke, expired, or went missing? Click Loss & Damage.
Counted the whole shelf? Click Inventory Count.
A delivery arrived? Click Purchase Orders and receive it.

title: See which items expire soon
text: Batch & Expiry shows one row per delivery, with its expiry date and batch number. The earliest date is on top.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Batch & Expiry.
Use the expiry filter to show only items due within a number of days.
Search by product, barcode, expiry date, or batch number.
Want different day ranges? Click Settings in the sidebar, then Products & Inventory.

title: Change a batch expiry date or split a batch
text: Edit changes the date, batch number, or quantity of one batch. Add more dates to split it into several batches.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Batch & Expiry.
Find the batch.
Click the arrow at the end of its row, then Edit.
Set the new date, batch number, and quantity. Or tick No Expiration.
Click Add Entry to give part of the stock a different date or batch number.
Click Save.

title: Write off a batch that is about to expire
text: A batch within 30 days of expiry can be written off from the Batch & Expiry page.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Batch & Expiry.
Find the batch.
Click the arrow at the end of its row, then Declare Loss & Damage.
Type the quantity and pick the reason.
Click Save. Stock goes down by that amount.

title: Print or export the stock list
text: Print & Export prints what is on screen, or saves it as PDF or Excel. Filter first, since it prints what you see.
steps: Click Inventory in the sidebar, then Stock on Hand.
Set your search, category, and stock filter.
Click Print & Export in the top bar.
Pick Print, PDF, or Excel.
